title: Resolve jpower entry selection mechanism (damageFlags=0 lookup)
description: Find why Goku's B move does 8 damage when jpower Block 0 only has total=50/100. The formula (totalDamage/7) would give 7 or 14, not 8. Investigate: tier bonus calculations, collision file contributions, or special move modifiers.

comments.author: DJ
comments.text: Partial discovery: damageFlags in collision = global jpower index for Ichigo. Goku uses damageFlags=0 which triggers unknown ARM9 lookup. Entries with total=40 exist at indices 146,195,218. Need to find ARM9 table that maps chr_b index to jpower index when damageFlags=0.

comments.author: DJ
comments.text: Deprioritized - waiting for more in-game damage data from Human Testing Queue. Key tests needed: Majin Buu (Block 0), Naruto (formula verification), Caramelman (tier=3 verification)

comments.author: DJ
comments.text:
MAJOR FINDINGS (2026-01-30):
1. Two damage systems discovered:
   - Ichigo pattern: damageFlags=jpower index (19/20 entries have flags>0)
   - Goku pattern: damageFlags=0 triggers ARM9 lookup (23/25 entries are 0)

2. ÷5+tier formula CONFIRMED for: Ichigo, Bankai, Naruto, Caramelman

3. BUU ANOMALY: B=9 requires total=45, but NO jpower entries have total=45!
   - Same Block 0 as Goku but completely different damage values
   - Possible character-specific modifier or hardcoded exception

Next: Find ARM9 table for damageFlags=0 lookup, investigate Buu exception

title: Locate character weight/walk speed data
description: Find where character weight and walk speed are stored. Not found in chr_b.bin. Possible locations: ARM9 binary hardcoded tables, alternate bin files, or derived from existing stats.

title: Verify damage formula across characters
description: Confirm the /7+tier formula is universal or find per-character variations. Test at least 5 diverse characters (different series, different attack patterns) to validate.
close_reason: Verified: damage1÷5 + (tier-2) formula confirmed across 15+ characters

title: Investigate Buu B=9 anomaly (no jpower total=45 exists)
close_reason: SOLVED: Formula is damage1÷5 + (tier-2), not totalDamage÷5. All anomalies explained.
